planets.name: K2-148 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-148 with a 4.38-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-148 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-148. Its orbit and size follow Hirano et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname HIRANO_ET_AL__2018): disc_year 2018, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 3; pl_orbper 4.38393, pl_radj 0.11865465, pl_bmassj 0.00733

quotes.title: K2-148b
quotes.card: K2-148b is a confirmed super-Earth, probably rocky, closely orbiting a small orange dwarf star.
quotes.introduction: It is the innermost of three Super-Earths around the star K2-148, which is in a wide binary pair with the M0.5V red dwarf EPIC 220194953.
